newsitem.title: USA: UST sees Q3 earnings just below estimates.
newsitem.headline: UST sees Q3 earnings just below estimates.

text.p: UST Inc said Thursday it expects earnings per share for the third quarter and the full year to be slightly lower than expected.
Earnings for the third quarter will be about $0.65 per share, and earnings for the full year are expected to be in the $2.44 to $2.46 range, the company said.
First Call had a third quarter earnings estimate for UST Inc of $0.66 per share and an estimate of $2.46 for the 1996 year.
The company said the lowered estimates are because of lower-than-anticipated unit volume for moist smokeless tobacco.

The company said the revised third quarter estimate still represents an 18 percent increase over the prior year third quarter earnings, and that the full year estimate represents a 13 to 14 percent increase over 1995 earnings.
